products.name: Google Nest Hub Max
products.priceNote: US MSRP $229.99, sourced verbatim from the Android Authority review ("MSRP: $229.99"). Consistent with Wikipedia's listed $229 launch price. Not present on the Google support spec page (no pricing there).
products.provenance: Google's official device specifications page (support.google.com/googlehome/answer/7072284) has a dedicated "Google Nest Hub Max" section listing a 10" HD touchscreen at 1280 x 800, a 6.5-megapixel camera with 127-degree FOV, "2 x 18 mm 10W tweeters, 1 x 75 mm 30W subwoofer", and "802.11b/g/n/ac (2.4 GHz or 5 GHz) Wi-Fi", "Bluetooth 5.0", "802.15.4 (at 2.4 GHz)" — confirming this exact model (camera-equipped 10-inch Max, distinct from the smaller cameraless Nest Hub). The Android Authority review corroborates the same 10-inch 1,280x800 display, 6.5MP camera and two-18mm-tweeter/75mm-subwoofer setup, states the MSRP as $229.99, notes Google released the Nest Hub Max in late 2019, and places it in the "Google Assistant ecosystem." audio watts is left blank (only per-driver 10W/30W figures are stated, not a summed total) and smart home hub is left blank (neither page makes a verbatim hub/Matter-controller claim for this specific model).
